Export a portable backup compatible with iOS. It includes your passport, entry-policy edits, visas, Been and Wishlist records, and profile. Friends and sharing identity are not supported on Android yet.
Local records win. Add new record IDs; keep this device’s passport and entry policies. Fill an empty profile name or photo from the backup.
Backup records win. Replace visas, Been and Wishlist; apply the included passport and policy edits. Media omitted from the file is preserved for matching visa IDs.

What do the map colours mean?

The Overview legend shows the colours for visa-free entry, visa on arrival, electronic authorisation, a valid personal visa and visa required. Your passport and visa validity determine eligibility. Dot markers identify countries in Been.
Can I rely on the entry information?

This app is a planning reference, not an official immigration decision. Rules can change. Always verify visa, transit and document requirements with official authorities and your airline before travel.
How do I change my passport?
Open Profile, choose your passport, then Save. Changing passport resets entry-policy edits to that passport’s bundled rules; personal visas and travel records remain.

Add your personal visa, validity dates, permitted stay and optional attachments. Valid visas can change accessible destinations. Schengen coverage applies to member countries; an expired or not-yet-effective visa does not.

Been records completed visits. Wishlist stores planned trips with optional dates or estimated duration. You can keep multiple trips per country and mark a plan completed to turn it into a visit. Day totals count complete date ranges inclusively.
Where is my data, and how do I transfer it?

Records and photos are stored on your device. Use Manage Data to export or import a portable JSON backup. Merge keeps local records; Replace uses backup records. Keep backups safe because they can include personal photos and visa documents.
How do I configure the dice?
Tap the dice for an eligible random destination. Long-press it to choose categories, continents, visited status and airline destinations. Dice options are not in the profile menu.
Report a problem or suggest a feature using a GitHub issue. You can copy basic app and device diagnostics to include with your report.
GitHub issues may be public. Do not include passport numbers, private visa documents or other sensitive information.
Where Can I Go helps you explore destinations, manage visas and keep your travel history and plans locally.
Your profile, passport selection, policy edits, visas and travel records are saved in this app’s local storage. This Android implementation does not upload them to an app account or friends service.

Photos and visa documents are read only when you select or capture them. The system photo picker grants access to selected items; the camera is opened through another app. Profile photos can be cropped, replaced or removed.

The world map and bundled country policies work offline. Search, feedback, source and social links open an external browser or app. Those services receive the requested URL and are governed by their own privacy policies.

Exported backups and shared summary images leave the app only through the destination or service you choose. A backup may contain sensitive documents and photos. Store it securely and delete unwanted copies yourself.

Android and your device’s backup settings may back up app data. Clear app storage or uninstall to remove local app data; separately remove exported backups and shared files. No background location tracking is used.
Entry policies are compiled from official authorities and attributed public references. Country boundaries are for visual planning only and do not imply a position on sovereignty.
Wikipedia-derived references are attributed in the repository’s source files and are available under CC BY-SA 4.0. Check the original pages for current rules and attribution.
